events.title: 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat Bolton to secure their first league win of the campaign, exiting the relegation zone as a result. In the Championship, 위건 애슬레틱 go back to the top of the table with a win over bottom club 로더럼 유나이티드, and Teddy Sheringham scores his 250th league goal with the winner for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 against 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
첼시 beat 리버풀 1–0 at Stamford Bridge and extend their run of not losing a match under 조제 모리뉴, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go four unbeaten since Bobby Robson's departure with a draw at 버밍엄 시티.
아스널 's record streak of unbeaten top-flight league matches ends at 49 after a 2–0 away loss to 맨체스터 유나이티드 .
Gary Megson is dismissed as manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 after he notifies the club he will not extend his contract past the current season.
첼시 cancels the contract of striker 아드리안 무투 after he tests positive for cocaine .

아스널 lead the Premier League on goal difference ahead of 첼시, while 에버턴's surprise title challenge is continuing as they occupy third place with just a three-point margin keeping them off the top. 미들즈브러 and 볼턴 원더러스 complete the top five, with 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 – among the pre-season title favourites – sixth and seventh respectively. 노리치 시티, 블랙번 로버스 and 사우샘프턴 occupy the bottom three. 위건 애슬레틱 are still top of the Championship, with 입스위치 타운 now second. The playoff zone is occupied by Reading, Queen's Park 레인저스, 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드.
